answer: The trellis test I would run is Enthroned cold chain auditor warrant with cold chain attestation: a warrant auditors renew after temperature audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the tide compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The knoll grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
